category: Query language: PCB membership/attribute keywords & schematic query keywords
description: Membership and attribute keywords of the PCB query language (InNet, InComponentClass, WithinRoom, HasFootprint, package-nature and net-statistics checks, unit conversion) and the schematic/schematic-library query keywords used in the SCH Filter, SCH List, Find Similar Objects and Constraint Manager scopes.

tools.name: InNet (query function)
tools.description: Returns every object associated with the named net(s): pads, vias, tracks, arcs, regions, polygons and the net object itself. Accepts a comma-separated list of names and wildcards. The primary scope keyword for net-specific rules.

parameters.name: NetName
parameters.description: One or more net names; * and ? wildcards permitted.

tools.example:
Width rule scope: InNet('VBUS')
PCB Filter: InNet('CLK_25M') And IsVia
tools.notes: InAnyNet returns all net-aware objects; nets are matched by name so renaming a net on the schematic breaks the scope until updated.

tools.name: InNetClass (query function)
tools.description: Returns the nets belonging to the named net class and all their primitives. Net classes come from the schematic (Class Generation, Net Class directives, buses/harnesses) or are made in Design > Classes; the class-based scope is the recommended way to keep rules stable while nets are added.
tools.example:
Clearance rule: InNetClass('HV') to All, 3 mm
PCB Filter: InNetClass('POWER') And IsTrack And (Width < 0.5mm)
tools.notes: Related: InStructureClass (classes of classes), InxSignalClass, InDifferentialPairClass.

tools.name: InAnyNet / InAnyComponent / InAnyDifferentialPair / InAnyxSignal (query keywords)
tools.description: Fast membership tests that return everything belonging to any net, any component, any differential pair or any xSignal respectively (parents plus children). Their negations isolate orphans: copper with no net, free primitives, unpaired routes.
tools.example:
OnCopper And Not InAnyNet And Not InAnyComponent   -- stray copper with no net
IsTrack And Not InAnyDifferentialPair And InNetClass('LVDS')
tools.notes: InAnyNet excludes objects whose net is 'No Net'; IsElectrical is the net-object equivalent.

tools.name: InComponent (query function)
tools.description: Returns the component with the given designator and all of its child primitives (pads, silkscreen, 3D bodies). Accepts several designators and wildcards, so InComponent('R*') matches every resistor.
tools.example:
Solder Mask Expansion rule scoped InComponent('J1') with 0.1 mm
PCB Filter: InComponent('U3') And IsPad
tools.notes: For pads of a specific footprint pin use HasFootprintPad('Footprint', 'PadName'); HasPad('U1-5') addresses one pad by full name.

tools.name: InComponentClass (query function)
tools.description: Returns components in the named component class plus their primitives. Component classes are generated per schematic sheet (Class Generation) or defined in Design > Classes; they are the usual scope for Component Clearance, Height, Permitted Layers, mask expansion and fanout rules.
tools.example:
Height rule: InComponentClass('UnderHeatsink') Maximum 3 mm
ComponentInLayerClass('OuterCopper') also exists for layer-class based tests.
tools.notes: InChannelClass('Channel') targets design-channel classes of multi-channel designs.

tools.name: WithinRoom / TouchesRoom (query functions)
tools.description: WithinRoom returns objects completely inside the named room(s); TouchesRoom returns objects partly or wholly inside. Rooms thus act as geometric scopes for any rule type (width, clearance, height, via style) and as selection filters.

parameters.name: RoomName
parameters.description: Room name(s) as defined in the Room Definition rule.

tools.example:
Clearance rule: WithinRoom('RF_Section') to All, 0.3 mm, priority above default
Routing Via Style: TouchesRoom('BGA_Fanout') with smaller vias
tools.notes: InRoom is not a keyword; use WithinRoom. Room names are those of the Room Definition rules (Design > Rules > Placement > Room Definition).

tools.name: InDifferentialPair / InDifferentialPairClass (query functions)
tools.description: InDifferentialPair returns the nets and primitives of the named pair(s); InDifferentialPairClass returns all pairs in a class. These are the scopes of Differential Pairs Routing, Matched Lengths (Within Differential Pair Length) and Return Path rules.
tools.example: Differential Pairs Routing rule: InDifferentialPairClass('USB3') Width 0.18 mm, Gap 0.15 mm
tools.notes: Pairs are defined by _P/_N (or custom) net-name suffixes in the PCB panel or via schematic Differential Pair directives.

tools.name: InxSignal / InxSignalClass / IsxSignal (query functions)
tools.description: InxSignal returns objects belonging to the named xSignal (a pin-to-pin path that may cross series components); InxSignalClass returns all xSignals in a class; IsxSignal returns the xSignal object itself. They scope Length and Matched Lengths rules for DDR, PCIe and similar buses.

parameters.name: Name / ClassName
parameters.description: xSignal or xSignal class name (wildcards allowed).

tools.example: Matched Lengths rule: InxSignalClass('DDR3_ADDR') tolerance 1 mm
tools.notes: Create xSignals with Design > xSignals > Run xSignal Wizard or from the PCB panel xSignals mode.

tools.name: InPadClass / InPolygonClass / InFromToClass / InLayerClass (query functions)
tools.description: Membership tests for the other class kinds managed in Design > Classes: pad classes (groups of pads for mask/clearance rules), polygon classes (pour order and connect styles), from-to classes (custom topologies) and layer classes (groups of layers; InLayerClass returns objects on any layer of the class, ComponentInLayerClass the components on those layers).
tools.example:
Paste Mask Expansion: InPadClass('ThermalPads') -20%
Clearance: InLayerClass('OuterLayers') 0.15 mm vs InLayerClass('InnerLayers') 0.1 mm
tools.notes: InFromTo('Net (Pad1 : Pad2)') addresses a single from-to.

tools.name: InStructureClass / InChannelClass / InLayerStackRegion (query functions)
tools.description: InStructureClass returns members of the net/component classes grouped under a structure class (hierarchical classes built from the schematic hierarchy); InChannelClass returns objects of components in a design channel class of a multi-channel design; InLayerStackRegion returns objects inside a named board region (rigid-flex sub-stack), enabling region-specific width/via rules.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: Structure class, channel class or layer-stack region name.

tools.example: Width rule: InLayerStackRegion('Flex1') Preferred 0.25 mm (wider on flex)
tools.notes: Structure classes are enabled in Project Options > Class Generation; layer stack regions are defined in Board Planning Mode.

tools.name: InPolygon / InNamedPolygon / IsNamedPolygon (query functions)
tools.description: InPolygon (alias InPoly) returns all polygon pours together with their child copper; InNamedPolygon('name') returns the children of one pour; IsNamedPolygon('name') returns only that pour object. Use them to exclude pour copper from selections or to scope Polygon Connect Style to a specific pour.

parameters.name: PolygonName
parameters.description: Polygon pour name as shown in the Polygon Manager.

tools.example: IsRegion And OnCopper And Not InPolygon   -- copper regions that are not pour output
tools.notes: Auto-named pours are detected with AutoAssignedName = 'True'.

tools.name: InUnion / InNamedUnion (query functions)
tools.description: Return the parent and child objects of a union (a grouped set of primitives/components moved as one, created with Tools > Convert > Create Union from selected objects). InUnion takes the union number, InNamedUnion the name shown in the PCB panel's Unions mode.
tools.example: InNamedUnion('LED_Bank') And IsComponent
tools.notes: Unions are managed in the PCB panel (Unions mode) and broken with Tools > Convert > Break Union.

tools.name: InRegion / InRegionAbsolute / InRegionRelative / OnGrid (query functions)
tools.description: Geometric membership: InRegion(X1,Y1,X2,Y2) (alias InRegionAbsolute) returns objects within a rectangle given in mils from the absolute origin; InRegionRelative uses the user-set origin; OnGrid(X,Y) returns objects whose coordinates are multiples of the given grid, exposing off-grid parts.
tools.example: IsComponent And Not OnGrid(50, 50)   -- components not on a 50 mil grid
tools.notes: Values are always mils regardless of the document unit setting.

tools.name: HasFootprint / HasFootprintPad / HasPad (query functions)
tools.description: HasFootprint('pattern') returns components whose footprint name matches (wildcards allowed) and their primitives; HasFootprintPad('footprint', 'padname') returns the named pad of every component using that footprint; HasPad('U1-1') returns the pad by its full designator-pin name. Ideal for rules that must hit a specific pin of every instance of a package.

parameters.name: Name / PadName
parameters.description: Pad designator within the footprint, or full 'Designator-Pin'.

tools.example: Paste Mask Expansion: HasFootprintPad('QFN-32-EP', '33') Expansion -0.3 mm (exposed pad)
tools.notes: Footprint names are matched against the footprint reference stored on the placed component.

tools.name: HasViaType / HasViaFeature / InDrillLayerPair (query functions)
tools.description: HasViaType('Type I'..'Type VII') selects vias by their IPC-4761 protection classification; HasViaFeature('Capping'|'Covering'|'Filling'|'Plugging'|'Tenting') by an individual feature; InDrillLayerPair('Top Layer - Bottom Layer') by the drill pair name from the Layer Stack Manager. Used for via-in-pad, back-drill and HDI rule scopes.
tools.usage: HasViaType('Type VII')  |  HasViaFeature('Filling')  |  InDrillLayerPair('Top Layer - Mid Layer 1')
tools.example: Vias Under SMD scope: IsVia And HasViaFeature('Filling') And HasViaFeature('Capping')
tools.notes: Via features are set in the via Properties panel (Solder Mask Expansion/IPC-4761 section) or via templates.

tools.name: IsSMTPin / IsThruPin / IsSMTComponent / IsThruComponent (query keywords)
tools.description: Pad and component technology checks: IsSMTPin returns surface-mount pads, IsThruPin through-hole pads; IsSMTComponent and IsThruComponent return components classified by their pads; InSMTComponent / InThruComponent return those components' child objects. Common in mask, testpoint and clearance scopes.
tools.usage: IsSMTPin | IsThruPin | IsSMTComponent | IsThruComponent | InSMTComponent | InThruComponent
tools.example: Solder Mask Expansion: IsThruPin 0.1 mm; Paste Mask Expansion: IsSMTPin -0.02 mm
tools.notes: A component with both pad types is classified by the majority/through-hole presence; check with the PCB List panel if in doubt.

tools.name: IsBGA / IsDIP / IsSOIC / IsLCC / IsPGA / IsSIP / IsEdgeConnector (query keywords)
tools.description: Package-nature checks derived from pad arrangement: IsBGA (grid array), IsDIP, IsSOIC (surface-mount DIP), IsLCC, IsPGA, IsSIP, IsSMSIP, IsEdgeConnector return matching components; the In... forms (InBGA, InDIP, InSOIC, InLCC, InPGA, InSIP, InSMSIP, InEdgeConnector) return their child objects. Used by the default Fanout Control rules and for BGA-specific via/clearance rules.
tools.usage: IsBGA | IsDIP | IsSOIC | IsLCC | IsPGA | IsSIP | IsSMSIP | IsEdgeConnector | InBGA | InSOIC ...
tools.example:
Routing Via Style: InBGA (smaller preferred via)
Fanout_BGA default rule scope: IsBGA
tools.notes: Pad-count fields (CompPinCount, RowCount, ColumnCount, BigRowCount, BigColumnCount) refine the classification.

tools.name: Pad shape checks (IsRoundPad, IsRectangularPad, IsOctagonalPad, IsRoundedRectangularPad, IsChamferedRectanglePad, IsCustomShapePad, IsOvalPad, IsSquarePad)
tools.description: Return pads by their shape on the pad's layer; the ...ShapeOnLayer('Layer') variants (e.g. IsRoundPadShapeOnLayer('Top Layer')) test the shape on a specific layer of a multilayer pad with per-layer shapes. Useful for finding pin-1 square pads or converting legacy octagonal pads.
tools.usage: IsSquarePad | IsRoundPad | IsRectangularPad | IsRoundedRectangularPad | IsOctagonalPad | IsOvalPad | IsChamferedRectanglePad | IsCustomShapePad | IsRoundPadShapeOnLayer('Top Layer')
tools.example: IsPad And IsSquarePad And OnMultiLayer   -- pin-1 markers of through-hole parts
tools.notes: Pad shapes are Round, Rectangular, Octagonal, Rounded Rectangle (and custom regions); Square/Oval are shape-plus-size interpretations.

tools.name: IsLinkedToPadViaTemplate / IsLinkedToPadViaLibrary / IsLinkedToAnyPadViaLibrary (query functions)
tools.description: Return pads/vias that use a named pad/via template, any template from a named Pad Via Library (.PvLib), or any library template at all. Lets rules and filters follow template usage rather than raw dimensions.
tools.example: IsVia And Not IsLinkedToAnyPadViaLibrary   -- vias with ad-hoc sizes
tools.notes: Routing Via Style in Template preferred mode restricts routing to listed templates.

tools.name: NetLength / NetPinCount / NetViaCount / TraceLength / ManHat (query fields)
tools.description: Net statistics for net objects: NetLength (total routed track+arc length), NetPinCount (pads on the net), NetViaCount (vias on the net); per-primitive lengths: TraceLength (length of a track/arc on a signal layer) and ManHat (Manhattan length of a track). Used in the PCB List panel and Filter for routing audits.
tools.usage: IsNet And (NetLength > 100mm)  |  IsNet And (NetPinCount = 1)  |  IsTrack And (TraceLength < 0.2mm)
tools.example: IsNet And (NetViaCount > 6) And InNetClass('CLOCKS')
tools.notes: Lengths follow the document unit unless a unit suffix or AsMM/AsMils is used.

tools.name: IsHorizontal / IsVertical / IsOblique / IsObliquePositive / IsObliqueNegative (query keywords)
tools.description: Track-direction checks: horizontal, vertical, +/-45 degree, +45 degree only, -45 degree only. Used to enforce layer routing directions on a legacy autorouted board or to select all diagonal segments for glossing.
tools.example: IsTrack And OnLayer('Mid Layer 1') And IsHorizontal   -- should be vertical-preferred layer
tools.notes: Arbitrary-angle tracks match none of these.

tools.name: IsFree / IsUserRouted / IsElectrical / IsWire (PCB query keywords)
tools.description: IsFree returns free (non-component) primitives; IsUserRouted returns objects placed manually rather than by the autorouter or automated tools; IsElectrical returns nets other than 'No Net'; IsWire returns tracks and arcs on signal layers or Multi-Layer (routed copper). Helpful for cleaning up autorouter output or auditing manual copper.
tools.example:
IsWire And Not IsUserRouted   -- autorouted copper to review
IsFree And IsPad And Not InAnyNet
tools.notes: IsWire in PCB has nothing to do with schematic wires.

tools.name: AsMM / AsMils (unit conversion query functions)
tools.description: Wrap a numeric field so the comparison value is interpreted in millimetres or mils regardless of the document's current unit, making stored rule scopes and filters portable between metric and imperial documents.
tools.usage: AsMM(Keyword) op value  |  AsMils(Keyword) op value

parameters.name: Keyword
parameters.description: Numeric field such as Width, HoleSize, TraceLength.

tools.example:
IsTrack And (AsMM(Width) < 0.1)
IsVia And (AsMils(HoleSize) <= 8)
tools.notes: Alternatively append a unit suffix (0.1mm, 8mil) to the literal; the schematic editor additionally offers AsInches, AsCM, AsMetres, AsDXPs.

tools.name: IsPart / IsSchComponent (schematic query function)
tools.description: Returns component (part) objects on a schematic sheet or in a schematic library; IsSchComponent is an alias. Combine with Object_* property checks, HasFootprint, HasParameter or InComponent to build SCH Filter and Find Similar Objects expressions.
tools.example:
IsPart And (Object_Comment Like '10k*')
IsPart And Not HasFootprint('*', True)   -- parts without a current footprint
tools.notes: Multi-part components match once per placed part; Object_PartId distinguishes parts.

tools.name: IsPin (schematic query function)
tools.description: Returns pin objects of placed parts (and library symbols). Pin properties are tested with Object_ElectricalType ('Input', 'Output', 'Passive', 'Power', 'I/O', 'HiZ', 'Open Collector', 'Open Emitter'), Object_IsHidden, Object_Length, Object_ShowName, Object_PinShowDesignator and IEEE symbol fields.
tools.example: IsPin And (Object_ElectricalType = 'Power') And (Object_IsHidden = 'True')   -- hidden power pins
tools.notes: Pins are child objects; use the SCH List panel with 'Filtered objects' to edit them in bulk.

tools.name: IsWire / IsBus / IsBusEntry / IsSignalHarness (schematic query functions)
tools.description: Return the electrical connection objects of a sheet: wires, buses, bus entries and signal harnesses. Use them to change line widths/colours in bulk (SCH List) or to check for off-grid wiring with the Object_LocationX/Y fields.
tools.example: IsWire And (LineWidth = 'Small')   -- in SCH List set all to Smallest
tools.notes: Junctions placed automatically are not objects; IsJunction only matches legacy manual junctions.

tools.name: IsNetLabel / IsPort / IsPowerObject / IsOffSheetConnector (schematic query functions)
tools.description: Return the net identifier objects: net labels, ports, power ports (VCC/GND symbols) and off-sheet connectors. Port properties are testable with Object_IOType ('Input', 'Output', 'Bidirectional', 'Unspecified'), Object_ArrowStyle, Object_TextColor; text is matched through the Text/Name style fields in the SCH List panel.
tools.example:
IsPort And (Object_IOType = 'Unspecified')   -- ports lacking a direction
IsPowerObject   -- then set Style/Colour in SCH List
tools.notes: Net identifier scope (flat/hierarchical/global) is a project option, not a query property.

tools.name: IsSheetSymbol / IsSheetEntry / IsSheetName / IsSheetFileName (schematic query functions)
tools.description: Return sheet symbols, their sheet entries and the two text children (sheet name and file name). Membership forms InSheetSymbol('name') and HasSheetEntry('entry') pick symbols by name or by an entry they contain; Object_SheetName / Object_SheetFileName test the values.
tools.usage: IsSheetSymbol | IsSheetEntry | IsSheetName | IsSheetFileName | InSheetSymbol('PSU') | HasSheetEntry('VIN')
tools.example: IsSheetSymbol And (Object_SheetFileName Like '*Power*.SchDoc')
tools.notes: Use Design > Synchronize Sheet Entries and Ports after bulk-editing entries.

tools.name: IsParameter / IsDesignator / IsComment (schematic query functions)
tools.description: Return parameter objects (all component/document parameters), the Designator parameter objects and the Comment parameter objects respectively. Because these are the visible text children of parts, the queries drive bulk font/visibility edits in the SCH List panel and are the basis of Find Similar Objects on a designator.
tools.example:
IsDesignator And Not IsSelected   -- then set FontId in SCH List
IsParameter And (Name = 'Manufacturer')
tools.notes: HasParameter('Name', 'Value') selects parts by parameter; Object_HasParameter returns their children.

tools.name: IsLabel / IsTextFrame / IsNote / IsImage (schematic query functions)
tools.description: Return graphical text and annotation objects: text strings (IsLabel), text frames, notes and images. Drawing primitives have their own checks: IsPolyline (lines), IsRectangle, IsRoundRectangle, IsArc, IsEllipticalArc, IsEllipse, IsPolygon, IsBezier, IsSymbol (IEEE symbols).
tools.usage: IsLabel | IsTextFrame | IsNote | IsImage | IsPolyline | IsRectangle | IsArc | IsEllipse | IsPolygon | IsBezier | IsSymbol
tools.example: IsLabel And (Text Like '=*')   -- special strings such as =Title, =SheetNumber
tools.notes: Sheet template graphics are excluded unless the template is edited directly.

tools.name: IsHarnessConnector / IsHarnessEntry / IsHarnessConnectorType (schematic query functions)
tools.description: Return signal-harness objects: harness connectors (the box that terminates a signal harness), their entries and the harness type text child. Used with IsSignalHarness for harness audits and bulk renaming.
tools.example: IsHarnessEntry And (Name Like 'SPI*')
tools.notes: Harness definition files (.Harness) are generated by the compiler from these objects.

tools.name: IsParameterSet / IsNoERC / IsCompileMask / IsBlanket / IsProbe (schematic query functions)
tools.description: Return design directive objects: parameter sets (PCB rule/class directives, differential pair, net class), No ERC markers, compile masks, blankets and probes. Handy to review every rule directive on a large project through the SCH List panel.
tools.example: IsParameterSet And HasParameter('DifferentialPair', '*')
tools.notes: Compile masks hide objects from the compiler; find forgotten ones with IsCompileMask before release.

tools.name: InComponent / InPart (schematic query functions)
tools.description: Return the parts with the listed designators together with their child objects (pins, parameters, designator/comment text). InPart is the canonical form and InComponent its alias; wildcards and multiple designators are accepted.
tools.example: InPart('U1') And IsPin And (Object_ElectricalType = 'Input')
tools.notes: Object_Designator = 'U1' returns the same children without the part itself.

tools.name: HasFootprint / HasModel (schematic query functions)
tools.description: HasFootprint('name', CurrentModelOnly) returns parts linked to a footprint model matching the pattern, optionally only when it is the current footprint; HasModel('Type', 'Name', CurrentModelOnly) does the same for any model domain: PCBLIB, SIM, SI (signal integrity), IBIS, PCB3DLib. Both have Object_ variants returning the parts' children.
tools.usage: HasFootprint('0603*', True)  |  HasModel('SIM', '*', True)  |  HasModel('PCBLIB', 'SOIC-8', False)

parameters.name: ModelName / ModelType
parameters.description: Model name pattern and domain type string.

parameters.name: CurrentModelOnly
parameters.description: True to test only the currently selected model.

tools.example: IsPart And Not HasModel('SIM', '*', True)   -- parts without a simulation model before running the simulator
tools.notes: HasModelParameter('Name', 'Value', CurrentModelOnly) tests model parameters such as the SPICE model file.

tools.name: HasParameter / HasPin (schematic query functions)
tools.description: HasParameter('Name', 'Value') returns objects (parts, ports, pins, sheet symbols, parameter sets...) carrying a parameter whose name and value match the patterns; HasPin('Designator', 'Name') returns parts that have a pin with the given designator and name. Both support wildcards.
tools.example: IsPart And Not HasParameter('Supplier Part Number 1', '*')   -- parts missing supply-chain data
tools.notes: Parameter Manager (Tools > Parameter Manager) is the batch editor for the results.

tools.name: Object_* property keywords (schematic)
tools.description: Family of schematic keywords that return the child objects of parents whose property matches: Object_Designator, Object_Comment, Object_LibReference, Object_LibraryName, Object_CurrentFootprint, Object_DesignItemID, Object_ComponentType, Object_PartId, Object_IsMirrored, Object_Orientation, Object_Locked, Object_PinsLocked, Object_ShowHiddenPins, Object_ElectricalType, Object_Length, Object_IsHidden, Object_IOType, Object_ArrowStyle, Object_Color, Object_AreaColor, Object_TextColor, Object_SheetName, Object_SheetFileName, Object_LocationX, Object_LocationY, Object_ObjectKind, Object_HasParameter, Object_HasFootprint, Object_HasModel, Object_HasPin, Object_HasSheetEntry.
tools.example: Object_LibReference Like 'CAP*' And IsComment   -- comment strings of all capacitors, e.g. to hide them
tools.notes: Because they return children, pair them with an Is... object check to pick the child kind you want.

tools.name: AsInches / AsCM / AsMetres / AsDXPs (schematic unit conversion functions)
tools.description: Schematic-editor unit wrappers for numeric properties (Object_LocationX, Object_Length, etc.): AsInches, AsCM, AsMetres and AsDXPs (DXP default units, 1/100 inch) join the AsMM/AsMils pair, so location and pin-length tests can be written in any unit independent of the document unit setting.
tools.example: IsPin And (AsDXPs(Object_Length) <> 30)   -- pins whose length is not the house standard
tools.notes: Schematic coordinates are stored in DXP units (10 mil); grids are usually 100 mil = 10 DXP units.

tools.name: IsSelected (schematic query keyword)
tools.description: Returns the currently selected schematic objects, allowing the SCH Filter/List to operate on the selection and letting Find Similar Objects results be refined with further conditions.
tools.example: IsSelected And IsPart   -- only the parts within the current selection (drop wires/labels)
tools.notes: Selection memory (Ctrl+1..8) and Edit > Select commands change what IsSelected returns.

tools.name: SCH Filter / SCH List query workflow
tools.description: Standard schematic query workflow: type or build a query in the SCH Filter panel (Helper/Builder available), choose Objects passing the filter: Select / Zoom / Mask (Dim) and scope (Current Document / Open Documents / Project), Apply; switch to the SCH List panel in 'Filtered objects' + 'Edit' mode to change properties of all matched objects at once, or right-click > Smart Grid Paste to import values from Excel.
tools.usage: View > Panels > SCH Filter  ->  Apply  ->  View > Panels > SCH List (Filtered objects, Edit)

parameters.name: Select / Zoom / Mask
parameters.description: What to do with matched objects.

tools.example: SCH Filter: IsDesignator And Not IsSelected, Mask enabled, Whole Project; SCH List: set FontId of the filtered designators to 'Arial 8'.
tools.notes: Shift+C or the Filter panel's Clear button clears the filter/mask. Find Similar Objects (Shift+F) generates a query automatically.
